explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/1048, using the open set {|f| < 1} as on the page. The universal claim (every monic non-constant f with roots in |z| ≤ r, 0 < r < 2, has an open-lemniscate component of diameter > 2-r) is negated, which is correct since Pommerenke's z^n - r^n with r > 1 and n large is a counterexample. The added 0 < r only restricts the universal statement, and the counterexample lies in that range.
